name: GIFT from GOD
source:
GIFT from GOD is a visual novel told through the eyes of Ryosuke Nikaido and Akane Yamamoto. As they face three missions from God, their hearts, pasts, and choices begin to intertwine, leading them toward the true meaning of God’s “gift.”

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4412980/]Steam[/url]]
